title: Fix settings wizard bundled toolchain paths
summary: Settings Wizard now discovers bundled FFmpeg/ffprobe from the promoted ops/pipeline/tools layout and normalizes quoted path inputs before validation or patch generation.
reason: Coordinator setup in portable packages should not require manually locating included toolchain executables, and Windows Explorer copy-as-path values should not fail because they include wrapping quotes.
behavior_before: Settings Wizard tool candidates looked under a stale Tools/ffmpeg/bin location, so bundled ffmpeg and ffprobe were not found in promoted portable packages. Quoted path inputs were treated as literal paths.
behavior_after: Settings Wizard tool candidates include the selected pipeline root and workspace ops/pipeline/tools/ffmpeg/bin locations. Wizard path-like fields strip one wrapping quote pair before validation and generated settings changes.
manual_validation: settings_wizard_defaults live check resolved ops/pipeline/tools/ffmpeg/bin ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe
rollback_plan: Revert src/mediapipeline/core/config/settings_wizard.py and the added test cases in tests/python/desktop/test_settings_wizard_policy.py, then refresh summaries.
notes: Fix wizard toolchain defaults plus quoted path validation without adding unsupported FFmpegPath/FFprobePath config keys.
